about.title: About Me
about.text: Software developer with a deep passion for problem solving. I was among the first to integrate Claude Code and AI agents into my daily workflow, combining traditional skills with artificial intelligence to achieve concrete results in speed and quality. I believe in clean code, elegant solutions, and user experiences that make a difference. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, gaming, or at the gym.

howIWork.title: How I Work
howIWork.description: Agile methodology focused on code quality, automated testing, and continuous integration. Every project starts with careful planning and ends with comprehensive documentation.

myPhilosophy.title: My Philosophy
myPhilosophy.description: I believe in clean code, simple solutions, and collaboration. Technology should serve people, not the other way around.

whatDrivesMe.title: What Drives Me?
whatDrivesMe.description: The challenge of solving complex problems with elegance. Every project is an opportunity to learn something new and improve my skills.

collaboration.title: Let's Collaborate
collaboration.description: I'm always open to new collaborations and exciting projects. If you have an idea or project, let's talk about it together.

current.description: AI-powered software development with Claude Code and AI agents. I collaborate with clients to transform complex requirements into innovative solutions, leveraging artificial intelligence to accelerate delivery and code quality.

previous1.description: Autonomous management of end-to-end client projects. Requirements analysis, feature development, code review and production deployments. Growth towards roles of greater responsibility within the team.

previous2.description: Integration into the enterprise development team. Hands-on involvement in real client projects, learning company best practices and building technical foundations.
